author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0036361 'racemase activity, acting on amino acids and derivatives
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29304

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1D3AggiR4CwP-RqZTN_1LJ5O0pRSVhI8cRcqf3mpTf-k/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
UniProt 2
CACAO 1
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 


GO:0036361 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR015942 Asp/Glu/hydantoin racemase > GO:racemase activity, acting on amino acids and derivatives ; GO:0036361
-- | -- | --

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0036361 racemase activity, acting on amino acids and derivatives
